subject.title: fix(mattermost): bound websocket handshake waits at 30s

question: Should Mattermost intentionally adopt a fixed 30-second WebSocket handshake deadline, accepting that slower upgrades will fail and enter reconnect backoff instead of waiting indefinitely?
rationale: The code and proof establish that the mechanism works, but choosing the permanent timeout value is an availability policy decision for existing Mattermost deployments rather than a mechanical correctness question.

options.title: Approve the fixed deadline
options.body: Accept 30 seconds as the Mattermost default, matching established sibling clients, then refresh the branch and merge.

options.title: Require an override
options.body: Add a narrowly documented Mattermost timeout setting only if owners know of legitimate deployments that regularly need more than 30 seconds.

options.title: Pause for field evidence
options.body: Keep the PR open until a Mattermost owner can validate the deadline against representative slow proxy or server environments.

recommendation.title: Approve the fixed deadline
recommendation.body: Accept 30 seconds as the Mattermost default, matching established sibling clients, then refresh the branch and merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the reconnect lifecycle this deadline feeds and have the strongest Mattermost-specific history.
